preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to call updateUniswapV2Router function
Contract must hold some BNB balance from accumulated fees

exploit_hint: Deploy a malicious router contract with a fallback/receive function that reenters the victim contract. As owner, call updateUniswapV2Router with the malicious router address. This will trigger the router's fallback function during the update process, allowing reentrancy into swapBack or other functions to drain BNB from the contract. The exploit leverages the lack of reentrancy guards in the router update function combined with the contract's BNB balance from accumulated fees.
